general.notes: Power dissipation stated as < 5 W (Typical 4.5W). Coupled fiber: 9/125um SMF. Signaling speed per lane: 53.125 ± 50 ppm (TX) and ± 100 ppm (RX). Launch power in OMA depends on max(TECQ,TDECQ): -1.8 dBm for max(TECQ,TDECQ)<1.4dB; -3.2+max(TECQ,TDECQ) dBm for 1.4dB≤max(TECQ,TDECQ)≤3.4dB. Receiver sensitivity (OMA): -6.5+TECQ dBm for 1.4dB<TECQ≤3.4dB per lane. TDECQ closure for PAM4 each lane max 3.4 dB. Optical receiver damage threshold Pdmg 5.0 dBm. FEC required to be implemented by the host; FEC type not specified. BER measured with PRBS31Q test pattern, BER@2.4*10^-4. Wavelength assignment suitable for all channels (note 3). Type 2A housing MPO-12 connector with 8° angled end-face. Integrated Silicon photonics modulator chip.
